3: ParseDelimiterSimple does not care about punctuations
//- - - - - - - - -//
a*"foo"*
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>a<em>&quot;foo&quot;</em></p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

4
OPTIONS: {"enableEscape": true}
//- - - - - - - - -//
*\xc2\xa0a\xc2\xa0*

<p>*\xc2\xa0a\xc2\xa0*</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

5: ParseDelimiterSimple does not care about punctuations

*£*bravo.

*€*charlie.

<p><em>€</em>charlie.</p>

112: ParseDelimiterSimple does not care about punctuations, but cares about other delimiters
//- - - - - - - - -//
*_foo_*
//- - - - - - - - -//

114: ParseDelimiterSimple does not care about punctuations, but cares about other delimiters
//- - - - - - - - -//
_*foo*_
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p><em><em>foo</em></em></p>

121

//- - - - - - - - -//

//- - - - - - - - -//

123

124

125

126

129

130

//- - - - - - - - -//

131

//- - - - - - - - -//

//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

132
//- - - - - - - - -//
__a<https://foo.bar/?q=__>

//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

200: ParseDelimiterSimple can emphasize around CJK punctuations
//- - - - - - - - -//
これは*「重要」*です。
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>これは<em>「重要」</em>です。</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//
